'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[Rudy Giuliani]], former [[Mayor of New York City|New York City mayor]] and personal lawyer to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]], tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] and is admitted to a hospital in [[Washington, D.C.]] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/06/politics/rudy-giuliani-coronavirus-positive/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,924 cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ontario-covid-19-update-december-6-1.5830417 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Bavaria]] formally declares a “disaster situation” in the [[States of Germany|state]] and announces to tighten its [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] restrictions starting from December 9, banning people from leaving their homes with some exception and a nightly curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time in communities that have more than 200 infections per 100,000 inhabitants within seven days. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-06/bavaria-tightens-covid-lockdown-and-declares-disaster-situation (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a new single-day record of 29,039 cases, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2.46 million. [https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN28G07M (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses 60,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/coronavirus-italy-passes-60-000-covid-19-related-deaths-1.4429213?mode=amp (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Sweden]] imposes new restrictions on large gatherings and issues alcohol sale curfews and school closures amid a rise of cases. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/long-a-holdout-from-covid-19-restrictions-sweden-ends-its-pandemic-experiment-11607261658 (''Wall Street Journal'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[South Korea]] reaches a nine-month high of 631 cases in the last 24 hours, the majority being from the [[Seoul Capital Area]]. The country now has 37,546 total confirmed cases, according to data from the [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]]. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201206000652320?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]
****The [[Government of South Korea|government]] decides to raise social distancing level to level 2.5 in the Seoul Capital Area for the next three weeks. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20201206000172 (''The Korea Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Indonesia]] receives its first shipment of 1.2 million doses of the [[CoronaVac]] vaccine. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/indonesia-first-covid-19-vaccine-china-sinovac-jokowi-13713098 (CNA)]
* [[Havana syndrome]]
** An expert committee of the U.S. [[National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine]] releases a report, concluding that "directed" [[microwave]] [[radiation]] was the likely cause of illnesses among American [[diplomat]]s in [[Cuba]] and [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55203844 (BBC News)]
*[[Eluru outbreak]]
**At least one person has died and 227 have been hospitalised by an unidentified illness in [[Eluru]], [[India]]. The patients had a wide range of symptoms from nausea to fits and falling unconscious, and all had tested negative for SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-55209763 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Indonesia]], [[Corruption Eradication Commission]]
**[[Indonesia]]n [[Onward Indonesia Cabinet|social affairs minister]] [[Juliari Batubara]] turns himself in to the [[Corruption Eradication Commission|national anti-corruption agency]] for [[COVID-19 pandemic]] aid [[Graft (politics)|graft]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/indonesia-minister-turns-covid-19-aid-graft-74564963 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]]
**The [[Arizona State Legislature]] announces that the [[Arizona House of Representatives|House]] and [[Arizona Senate|Senate]] will close for a week starting tomorrow due to COVID-19 concerns. The move comes shortly after [[Rudy Giuliani]], who met with several [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] lawmakers to discuss supposed [[electoral fraud|election fraud]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]], tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.fox10phoenix.com/news/arizona-house-of-representatives-building-to-close-on-dec-7-for-one-week-due-to-rise-of-covid-19 (KSAZ-TV)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2020/12/07/arizona-legislature-closed-covid-giuliani/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2020 Romanian legislative election]]
**Voters in [[Romania]] head out to [[Elections in Romania|elect]] the members of their country's [[Chamber of Deputies (Romania)|Chamber of Deputies]] and [[Senate of Romania|Senate]]. Widespread lack of interest in politics and the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania|COVID-19 pandemic]] have raised fears of a low voter turnout. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20201206-low-turnout-expected-at-romania-s-elections-in-the-shadow-the-coronavirus (France 24)]
*[[2020 Venezuelan parliamentary election]]
**[[Elections in Venezuela|Parliamentary elections]] are underway in [[Venezuela]] amidst [[Crisis in Venezuela during the Bolivarian Revolution|multiple]] [[2013–present economic crisis in Venezuela|ongoing]] [[Venezuelan presidential crisis|crises]]. The election is boycotted by the political opposition to [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] and has been called unfair by international observers. [https://www.dw.com/en/venezuelans-vote-in-parliamentary-election-amid-deep-crises/a-55836514 (DW)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**[[Cameroon]] holds its first regional elections amidst criticism of [[President of Cameroon|President]] [[Paul Biya]] and a growing [[Anglophone Crisis|separatist insurgency]] in the [[English language|English]]-speaking areas of the country. The election will elect representatives to local councils and is supported by the [[government of Cameroon|government]], whereas separatists have vowed to disrupt the election, arresting anyone participating in it. Gunfire is also reported in some areas. [https://www.reuters.com/article/cameroon-election/cameroon-holds-first-ever-regional-elections-separatists-vow-disruption-idUSKBN28G0AW?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Supporters of [[President of Moldova|President-elect]] [[Maia Sandu]] gather in [[Moldova]] to call for the resignation of the [[Russia]]-backed [[Politics of Moldova|government]] and a new parliamentary election. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/amp/Protesters-in-Moldova-demand-early-parliamentary-15779772.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Uncrewed spaceflights to the International Space Station]]
**A [[SpaceX]] [[Falcon 9]] launches a cargo ship into orbit to re-supply the [[International Space Station]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/spacex-launch-dragon-cargo-ship-space-station/ (CBS News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020 NFL season]]
**In [[American football]], the [[Cleveland Browns]] defeat the [[Tennessee Titans]] 41-35 to secure their first winning season since 2007. [https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/pro/browns/2020/12/06/browns-titans-score-baker-mayfield-nfl-week-13-myles-garrett/3801591001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2020 Formula One World Championship]]
**[[Racing Point F1 Team|Racing Point]]'s [[Sergio Pérez]] wins the [[2020 Sakhir Grand Prix]] at the [[Bahrain International Circuit]], claiming his first Formula One win, and becoming the first Mexican Formula One driver to win a race since [[Pedro Rodríguez (racing driver)|Pedro Rodríguez]] won the [[1970 Belgian Grand Prix]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/dec/06/sergio-perez-wins-sakhir-grand-prix-after-george-russell-robbed-by-puncture (''The Guardian'')]
